title: 950. Least Operators to Express Number

examples.explanation: The flat chain 3*3+3*3+3/3 evaluates to 9+9+1 with 5 operators, and nothing shorter reaches 19.
The chain 5*5*5*5-5*5*5+5/5 evaluates to 625-125+1 with 8 operators, which is optimal.
The target equals 100^4, built with 3 multiplications and nothing else.

hints: Compare building up from the power below the target against overshooting the power above and subtracting.
Powers of x cost (exponent - 1) multiplications; the value 1 costs one division (x/x).
Memoize on the remaining value — only logarithmically many states appear.
